capabilities: Edit plain text files with optional line numbers and a monospace or theme font
Convert notes between .md and .txt (or other configured extensions) via right-click
Configure which file extensions the plugin handles
Convert a file's line endings between LF, CRLF, and CR
Open non-UTF-8 files read-only with a warning instead of corrupting them
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; the README ends with a buy-me-a-coffee donation request.
problem: Obsidian's editor is built around Markdown notes, so plain text files lack a dedicated editing experience with line numbers, font options, and safe handling of non-UTF-8 encodings.
summary: Minimal editor for plain text files (.txt and custom extensions) with optional line numbers, font choice, and conversion between Markdown notes and text files.
